label: EU-mdr-2017 Article 102

obligations.text: The competent authorities of the Member States shall cooperate with each other and with the Commission.
The Commission shall provide for the organisation of exchanges of information necessary to enable this Regulation to be applied uniformly.

Member States shall, with the support of the Commission, participate, where appropriate, in initiatives developed at international level with the aim of ensuring cooperation between regulatory authorities in the field of medical devices.
